audit.why: diff EVEN at 5.5/10 against 52.03% over 3525 games is a fair read: the lane is a coin-flip that hinges on whether Galio can taunt inside 275 while Naafiri has three untargetable windows (W, E, R) to leave with. The prose framing of 'her window is 3 through first item' is consistent with her kit having every dash online by 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is attributed to an ultimate called 'Pack Your Bags', which does not exist. It appears in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[2].
audit.why: Naafiri's R is Hounds' Pursuit: 110/95/80s cooldown, 900 range, a pack dash with a recast that grants a shield. 'Pack Your Bags' is a fabricated name — packet.defects already flags that the page never names any of her real abilities.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Hounds' Pursuit, 900 range on 110s at rank 1 falling to 80s at rank 3, with a recast that shields her. Galio's matching spike is Hero's Entrance at 180s/4000 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names no Naafiri ability anywhere and never states the interaction that decides the lane: Eviscerate is a 450-unit dash out of Galio's 275-range taunt that also fully heals her packmates.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them', 11/10/9/8/7s, 450 range, with heal and untargetable flags. Galio's W taunt has 275 range and an 18s cooldown at rank 1 — she out-ranges the release by 175 units on a cooldown roughly half as long. missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal on exactly this ability.
audit.corrected: Charge W only with Eviscerate on cooldown; it is an 11s dash at rank 1 that leaves the taunt radius and heals the pack back. Grievous Wounds is what makes extended trades hold.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) — it read as flavour about counting 'out loud'.
audit.why: The three cooldowns that actually gate this lane are all in the kits: Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80, Eviscerate 11/10/9/8/7, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the field, tied to what each one permits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told the reader that W, E and R all grant Untargetable, so a timed Galio commit can hit nothing at all.
audit.why: enemyKit flags untargetable on W (26/24/22/20/18), E and R. That is three separate ways to blank a charged taunt or an incoming Hero's Entrance.
